items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: But I mean Jimmy Noone was working at -- working upstairs, and we were downstairs.

ctx.x: Well this sounds like he's putting a whole new group together.

Yes. And now I see. That's the way it looks to me, now, because he went in, and Joe Sherman, at the -- uh, uh, on -- down the Loop there, Randolph Street, 68 Randolph Street. Yeah. Joe Sherman. I'm trying to think of the name of the damn club. Uh, uh, uh, (smack, smack) (unintelligible) at the [meantime] and Jimmy Noone was there with his band at the same time.
Well this was much earlier, was the Apex.
